name: Amanda Kerr
life: “I still remember practicing a note against a refrigerator motor.” On Thursday, near the brick passage off the shop row, Amanda takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I sang against the hum to steady my voice for an audition. I got the part of a woman at sea.
appearance: Amanda has a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek. Look for a center part and straight chestnut hair. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a dark green knitted vest with a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring. In conversation Amanda listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Amanda often says yes too quickly out of pride in being useful. The people closest to Amanda have learned to ask again the next morning, when the answer is more likely to account for sleep.
agenda: To send the skipper a ticket to the show.
family: Jody Mehta is Amanda’s half-sibling. Amanda is free to hang up first. Jody makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The spare spectacles*, Jody says, “I know that bent temple. I repaired it for my former partner after we split up.”
connections: Alex Carbone. The singer and tune arranger each try setting a melody against the harbor's actual note.
